Active Pro subscription is a positive signal; 8 days left gives real but uncertain odds.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for getting back to me -- busy weeks happen, and there's no pressure here. When you do dig in, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and projects are the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm happy to spend 20 minutes with you on a call this week and get that first project and a few real tasks in place together -- just tell me a time that suits.

Best,
Nadia
